nodes.label: CodeHive brand logo
nodes.summary: A flat, high-contrast logo: a golden-yellow hexagonal badge outlined in dark navy, centered around a navy coding symbol made from angle brackets and a forward slash. It conveys CodeHive's programming-focused product identity.

nodes.label: Programming identity
nodes.summary: The central angle brackets and slash are the conventional visual language for source code and software development.

nodes.label: Hexagonal badge motif
nodes.summary: The enclosing six-sided badge gives the mark a compact emblem-like silhouette that supports the CodeHive name and a hive-inspired visual identity.

nodes.label: High-contrast navy and gold palette
nodes.summary: The saturated gold field and dark navy outline and code glyph make the emblem legible at a glance and visually associate the product with a bee or honeycomb palette.
